scope: Only two completed own-source PR784 browser demo and standalone IPhreeqc WASM jobs; exact API/run/attempt/head/base/checkout tree and parents, all successful steps, source scripts and actual terminal/control outputs independently verified.
limits: Demo covers browser solver readiness/foam, Story/Sandbox reload and storage isolation, typed quota/recovery boundaries, rendering/speciation, five R1 scenarios online/offline, five semantic DOM goldens, PWA, German and responsive UX. Successful logged-check counts describe actual output, not independent physical experiments or universal UI coverage.

Standalone IPhreeqc script checks string database/solution admission, AgCl equilibrium range, native OH thermochemistry and MY-BASIC USER_PUNCH. It has no twenty-case cache/scenario matrix; cache/scenario acceptance belongs to separate demo/bench/bridge evidence.
Zero Svelte errors coexist with two warnings in two files; this receipt does not claim zero warnings.
Ordinary hosted lock and actual packaged browser/solver binary bytes are uncaptured; no local/fleet lock or artifact is substituted. Cached tools/dependencies remain qualified by raw logs.
Whole own CI completed success in captured API, but aggregate per-job/required-gate acceptance belongs to a separate review. Fleet and integration remain unaccepted.
No empirical chemistry, calibration, universal runtime accuracy, repaired-source standalone CLI12/CLI15 acceptance, deployment or merge claim. Reviewer executes no Cargo/browser/CLI/WASM code.
